title: Step 2a - Building a Simple Linear Regression Model with Scikit-learn in Python

cues.en: -: Okay, my friends.
cues.zh: 各位朋友。

cues.en: So, we just covered the data pre-processing part and we covered it in Flashlight thanks to our data pre-processing template.
cues.zh: 剛才透過資料前處理模板，很快完成了資料準備。

cues.en: And now we're about to really build and train the simple linear regression model on the training set, of course.
cues.zh: 現在要真正建立並訓練簡單線性迴歸模型，當然是在訓練集上。

cues.en: Right?
cues.zh: 對吧？

cues.en: Remember that we split it, the data set into the training set and the test set.
cues.zh: 別忘了，已把資料切成訓練集與測試集。

cues.en: The training set will be used to train our simple linear regression model and the test set will be used to evaluate it.
cues.zh: 訓練集用來訓練簡單線性迴歸，測試集用來評估。

cues.en: So now we have to start with the training.
cues.zh: 所以先開始訓練。

cues.en: And so there we go.
cues.zh: 開始吧。

cues.en: Let's create a new code cell, and let's implement the very simple linear regression model.
cues.zh: 新增程式儲存格，實作簡單線性迴歸模型。

cues.en: All right, so the first thing we'll have to do is to import the right class with which we're gonna build this simple linear regression model.
cues.zh: 首先，必須匯入用來建立模型的正確類別。

cues.en: Because indeed we could either implement it from scratch or we could use libraries.
cues.zh: 我們可以從演算法底層自行實作，也可以用函式庫。

cues.en: And of course, we're gonna use libraries because I wanna provide a very clear code template which allows you to build any simple linear regression models in Flashlight.
cues.zh: 這裡當然用函式庫，因為要提供清楚的模板，讓你快速建立各種簡單線性迴歸模型。

cues.en: And this library that we're gonna use is Scikit-learn from which we're gonna get access to a certain module called linear model.
cues.zh: 使用的是 scikit-learn，裡面有個 linear_model 模組。

cues.en: And from this module we're gonna call a certain class called linear regression.
cues.zh: 從這個模組，匯入 LinearRegression 類別。

cues.en: And our simple linear regression model which we're gonna build will be exactly an instance of this class, right?
cues.zh: 接下來建立的模型，就是這個類別的實例。

cues.en: It will be an object of this class.
cues.zh: 也就是它的物件。

cues.en: All right, so let's do this.
cues.zh: 現在開始。

cues.en: Let's start by importing from, you know from the Psikit-learn library which has the codename sklearn.
cues.zh: 先從代號為 sklearn 的 scikit-learn 函式庫匯入。

cues.en: So from sklearn, then as we said, we're gonna get access to a certain module so we have to add a dot here, and which is linear model.
cues.zh: 寫 from sklearn，再加句點存取 linear_model 模組。

cues.en: And from this linear module of the Scikit-learn library, well we are gonna import the linear regression class.
cues.zh: 從這個模組匯入 LinearRegression 類別。

cues.en: Exactly this one, linear regression.
cues.zh: 就是這個 LinearRegression。

cues.en: And then, as we said, this simple linear regression model which we're gonna build, will be an instance or an object of this linear regression class.
cues.zh: 如前所述，簡單線性迴歸模型就是這個類別的實例或物件。

cues.en: And therefore here we have to create a new variable which will be exactly this instance of the linear regression class.
cues.zh: 因此，這裡建立一個新變數，作為 LinearRegression 的實例。

cues.en: And we're gonna call this object, we can call it by any name, but we're gonna call it regressor because indeed we are doing right now regression, right?
cues.zh: 名稱其實可以任選，我們叫它 regressor，因為現在正在做迴歸。

cues.en: I remind the big difference between regression and classification regression is when you have to predict a continuous real value, like a salary,
cues.zh: 提醒一下，迴歸與分類的主要差別，是迴歸預測連續實數，例如薪資，

cues.en: as we're about to do.
cues.zh: 也就是現在要做的事情。

cues.en: And classification is when you have to predict a category or you know, a class, which we will do in part three, Classification.
cues.zh: 分類則預測類別，第三部分 Classification 會學到。

cues.en: All right, so, regressor, that's a new variable, which at the same time will become the object of the linear regression class.
cues.zh: 所以 regressor 是新變數，同時也是 LinearRegression 類別的物件。

cues.en: And you can exactly see this object as the linear regression model itself.
cues.zh: 可以直接把這個物件看成線性迴歸模型本身。

cues.en: You know, I remind that a class allows you to implement a couple of instructions to build something.
cues.zh: 類別提供一組指令，讓你建立某種東西。

cues.en: And, well, this linear regression class builds exactly the simple linear regression model.
cues.zh: 而 LinearRegression 類別，建立的正是簡單線性迴歸模型。

cues.en: Alright.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So you have to see this regressor object as exactly this model.
cues.zh: 所以，把 regressor 物件理解為模型本身。

cues.en: Right?
cues.zh: 明白嗎？

cues.en: So regression.
cues.zh: 寫 regressor。

cues.en: And then to create an object of a class, well there is nothing more simple.
cues.zh: 建立類別物件，非常簡單。

cues.en: You just have to call the class itself LinearRegression and then add some parentheses, and that's it.
cues.zh: 呼叫 LinearRegression，再加括號，就完成。

cues.en: Usually there are some parameters inside that we can implement, but here, you don't have to enter anything.
cues.zh: 通常括號裡可以設定參數，但這裡不用傳任何值。

cues.en: This will just create the simple linear regression model, and it is so simple that usually, we don't have to play too much with the parameters, alright?
cues.zh: 這樣就會建立模型，因為很簡單，通常不需要太多參數調整。

cues.en: And that line of code directly creates the simple linear regression model.
cues.zh: 這行程式直接建立簡單線性迴歸模型。

cues.en: And that's only the building part.
cues.zh: 但這只是建立的部分。

cues.en: You know, we actually get a model.
cues.zh: 我們現在有了模型。

cues.en: But now, of course, we have to train it on the training set and therefore we have to connect it in some way to the training set.
cues.zh: 接著當然要在訓練集上訓練，所以必須用某種方式，把它和訓練集連結。

cues.en: And the action, or you know the function that connects it in order to train it is called the fit function.
cues.zh: 用來連結並訓練模型的方法，叫做 fit。
